quests.title: Garden Fairies

dialogue.t: Oh, it's you, Golden Nara.
Nara friend, come play with Aralila! Aranishat is very weak. Don't play with him.
Pfft, Aralila lost to Aranishat last time, so Aralila is weaker.
Fine, let's not bother about the sun and moon. Nara friend is here, so let's play with Nara friend. Let's compete to see who is stronger.
Fine, let's compete. Aranishat's not scared.
Aralila hides first, then Nara friend comes to search. After that, Aranishat will hide, and Nara friend will search. The one who gets found first loses.
Do you want to play, Nara Friend? Let's start right away if you're ready!
Do you want to play, Nara Friend? Let's start right away if you're ready!
Hehe, I'll beat Aranishat this time!
Good Nara, do not forget! I will have a decisive battle against Aralila!
Hahahahaha! Aralila is weaker!
Golden Nara is indeed impressive to see through it so quickly... Hmm...
Golden Nara is impressive, but it's mainly because Aralila is too weak. Aranishat will not be found so quickly. Humph! Just watch.
What? How!?
Aranishat was also found quickly. As weak as Aralila!
Wah... All weak. Only Golden Nara is strong...
This is bad! Must train Ararakalari. With very strong Ararakalari, Nara friend won't be able to find me!

dialogue.sit: I don't think that's how this works...

dialogue.t: Are you afraid of losing? There's no need to care about winning or losing when playing games!
Even though I lost, I had fun. Golden Nara is a good Nara after all.
Our Nara friend wins. Awesome! Please take our flowers!
Thank you, good Nara! You are a good friend!

quests.description: At Festival Utsava, Aralila and Aranishat seem to be fighting over something…
